Erzsébetváros (7. kerület) — Budapest, Hungary

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

The heart of Budapest's "romkocsma" (ruin bar) scene and the core of the "Bulinegyed" party district, named in the July 2025 citywide theft-hotspot map. This is also where, in February 2025, Hungarian police (nearly 200 officers, 10 simultaneous raids) dismantled an organised fraud ring that used dating apps to lure foreign male tourists to bars in the VII-VIII district area and inflate their drink bills by huge margins — 33 identified victims, over 1 billion forints in damage, more than 30 charges per suspect. Residents also complained in May 2025 about worsening street-level disorder (public vomiting, bars expanding into former parking areas) linked to the same nightlife concentration. The same January 2025 dedicated party-district police station covers this area. Sources checked: Police.hu, 13 Feb 2025 (organised tourist-scam bar-tab fraud ring, 10 arrests); Metropol.hu, May 2025 (resident complaints, nightlife expansion); Index.hu, 31 Jan 2025 (dedicated Bulinegyed police station); Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
